question: Which oxidation level of hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) is most appropriate when lifting natural hair colour by four levels?
options: A. 10 volume (3%)
B. 20 volume (6%)
C. 40 volume (12%)
D. 30 volume (9%)

question: When performing a chemical relaxer service, the relaxer should be applied last to which section of the hair?
options: A. The nape section
B. The crown and top sections
C. The most resistant and least damaged areas
D. The previously relaxed ends

question: Which type of hair bond is permanently broken during a chemical relaxer service and cannot be reformed?
options: A. Hydrogen bonds
B. Salt bonds
C. Disulfide bonds
D. Van der Waals forces

question: A client presents with a positive patch test result 24 hours before a scheduled colour appointment. What is the most appropriate professional response?
options: A. Proceed with the service using a lower developer volume
B. Postpone the service and refer the client to a dermatologist
C. Apply a barrier cream and proceed with the service
D. Perform a strand test before proceeding

question: In the context of CVQ Cosmetology, which legislation in most Caribbean territories governs the safe handling and disposal of hazardous salon chemicals?
options: A. Occupational Safety and Health Act
B. Trade Licensing Act
C. Public Health Ordinance
D. Environmental Management Act

question: During a permanent wave service, the neutraliser performs which primary chemical function?
options: A. Softens and swells the hair cuticle to accept the wave solution
B. Raises the pH to open disulfide bonds
C. Re-forms disulfide bonds in the new waved configuration
D. Deposits pigment into the cortex to enhance shine

question: Which scalp condition is characterised by dry, white, non-adherent flakes and requires a different treatment approach than seborrhoeic dermatitis?
options: A. Tinea capitis
B. Pityriasis simplex (dry dandruff)
C. Psoriasis
D. Folliculitis

question: A colourist wants to create a tonal correction on hair that has been over-lifted to a pale yellow (level 10). Which colour theory principle dictates the correct toner selection?
options: A. Apply a violet-based toner to neutralise yellow tones
B. Apply a green-based toner to counteract orange tones
C. Apply a red-based toner to add warmth
D. Apply a blue-based toner to deepen the level

question: Which test is performed during a chemical service to assess the hair's internal strength and degree of processing?
options: A. Porosity test
B. Elasticity test
C. Strand test
D. Texture test

question: When analysing a client's hair for a colour service, you identify low porosity. What adjustment should be made to the colouring process?
options: A. Use a lower volume developer to prevent over-processing
B. Apply additional heat or pre-soften the hair to open the cuticle
C. Increase the hydrogen peroxide concentration significantly
D. Select a colour one level lighter than the target shade

question: Which facial shape is considered the ideal benchmark against which all other facial shapes are analysed when recommending hairstyles?
options: A. Heart
B. Square
C. Oval
D. Round

question: In the context of salon business management within CVQ Cosmetology, what does the acronym COGS represent?
options: A. Cost of Generating Services
B. Certificate of Good Standing
C. Cost of Goods Sold
D. Control of General Supplies

question: A sodium hydroxide relaxer has a pH of approximately 12–14. What is the first step the stylist must take if this product contacts a client's eye?
options: A. Apply a neutralising shampoo immediately to the affected eye
B. Flush the eye continuously with cool water for at least 15–20 minutes and seek medical attention
C. Cover the eye with a sterile pad and continue the service
D. Apply petroleum jelly around the eye socket and rinse with milk

question: Which sectioning pattern is used in a uniform-layer haircut to ensure all hair is cut to the same length regardless of growth direction?
options: A. Diagonal forward sections elevated to 45 degrees
B. Pivoting sections radiated from a single point, elevated to 90 degrees throughout
C. Horizontal sections with zero elevation
D. Vertical sections elevated to 180 degrees

question: Under CVQ standards, which document must be completed and signed by both the client and the stylist before any chemical service is performed?
options: A. Service receipt and payment confirmation
B. Client record card and informed consent form
C. Patch test result log only
D. Insurance indemnity waiver
